✅ Open Source & Free

jesherhead is completely open source and will always be free. No hidden fees, no premium tiers, no paywalls. Ever.

🔒 Safe & Secure

Our code is transparent and auditable. No shady backdoors or data collection. Your privacy matters.

⚡ Blazing Fast & Efficient

A single static page served via CDN with zero backend bloat. Games cache locally after the first load for instant replays and minimal data use. Lightweight and fast, even on restricted school networks and low-end devices.

© DMCA Info

Games on this page are loaded through LuminSDK. We do not host game files.

How LuminSDK works

LuminSDK acts as a proxy, retrieving and displaying game content from third-party sources. It does not upload, store, or control the underlying game files on its own servers.

Filing a takedown notice

If you believe content accessible through LuminSDK infringes your copyright, send a DMCA takedown notice to the designated agent at dmca@luminsdk.com with: your signature, identification of the infringed work, the infringing material URL or game title, your contact info, a good-faith statement, and an accuracy statement under penalty of perjury.

Full policy

Read the full policy at luminsdk.com/dmca. Counter-notifications go to the same agent. Repeat infringers have access terminated per the DMCA.
